name: mrtrix3 - WMC Anatomically Constrained Tractography (ACT)
summary: Generates a whole-brain tractogram with MRtrix3 anatomically constrained probabilistic (iFOD2) tractography from preprocessed DWI and a T1w image, with settings preset for white matter tract segmentation.
description: Runs the same RACE-Track code as the MRtrix3 ACT App (FSL bet mask, 5ttgen fsl, tensor and CSD fits, tckgen seeded at the grey-white matter interface) but exposes only iFOD2 probabilistic tracking with defaults for tract segmentation (1.5 million streamlines, 25-220 mm, curvature 35). Use it before white matter classification Apps. Needs a preprocessed DWI and a T1w image aligned to it.

inputs.description: Preprocessed DWI with bvecs and bvals.
inputs.requirements: Must contain b=0 volumes; single- or multi-shell.

inputs.description: T1-weighted image aligned to the DWI, used by 5ttgen fsl to build the five-tissue-type image for ACT.
inputs.requirements: If already skull-stripped, set premask to true.

outputs.description: Ensemble tractogram (track.tck) merging the streamlines from every requested algorithm, lmax and curvature.
Tensor-model outputs (fa, md, ad, rd, cl, cp, cs, tensor and kurtosis files). Note: in this branch the code copies fa.nii.gz into every file of this folder, so only fa is correct.
CSD fibre orientation distributions per lmax (lmaxN.nii.gz), normalised when norm is true.

parameters.description: the minimum length a streamline may be
the maximum length a streamline may be
This will find the maximum possible lmax within the data and use that.
perform ensemble tracking on every lmax up to the maximum value passed
the maximum curvature angle streamline can take during tracking
the number of streamlines to produce
If the input anatomical T1s have already been skull stripped, check this to prevent 5ttgen from cutting off a portion of the brain.  (This sets -premasked option for 5ttgens)
b-value of the shell to extract for the tensor fit with multi-shell data; ignored for single-shell data, and if the b-value is absent all shells are used.

failure_modes.message: iFOD2 Probabilistic tracking timed out with settings
failure_modes.cause: tckgen exceeded the 24000 s timeout without reaching the requested count.
failure_modes.fix: Lower num_fibers or the number of lmax/curvature combinations.

failure_modes.cause: The merged tractogram has fewer streamlines than requested.
failure_modes.fix: Check the log for the failing tckgen run and adjust the tracking parameters.
